description: Hold or free a Mac-wide lock tied to your lease. `perf-slot` is for fair speed tests: while you hold it the farm boots, clones and screenshots nothing else, and it records how busy the Mac is every second. It waits only for farm work in flight, not for other runs to end, so other sims and other apps may still use the Mac. run_benchmark_batch on your farm sim then marks each run fair or unfair from that record; run the unfair cases again. Measure only while you hold it. Other names guard shared test fixtures (e.g. `ask-buoy-gateway`, `shop`). Locks end with the lease.

epoch.description: The epoch from sim_farm_acquire. A stale epoch is refused.

hold.description: true = take it, false = free it.

name: sim_farm_lock
